T.topic_fa: گوچی بی‌سروصدا قیمت کیف «پدلاک» را ۳۰٪ پایین آورد. شرکت مادر لویی ویتون که پارسال گفته بود «ما کوکاکولا نیستیم»، حالا درباره‌ی کاهش قیمت حرف می‌زند. و هرمس قیمتش را نگه داشت و رشد کرد
T.topic_en: Gucci quietly cut its Padlock bag by 30%. Louis Vuitton's owner once said 'We're not Coca-Cola' and is now discussing cuts. Hermès held its prices and its leather goods grew 10.8%
T.central_tension_fa: در بیشتر بازارها قیمت کمتر یعنی مشتری بیشتر؛ در لاکچری قیمت خودش محصول است. تخفیف به خریدار تازه می‌گوید «حالا بخر» و به کسی که دیروز خریده می‌گوید «گران خریدی». مشکل گوچی قیمت نبود، خواستنی‌بودن بود؛ و تخفیف قیمت را درست می‌کند، نه خواستن را.
T.central_tension_en: Everywhere else a lower price wins customers. In luxury the price is the product. A cut tells new buyers 'now' and tells yesterday's buyers 'you overpaid'. Gucci's problem wasn't price, it was desire, and a discount fixes price, not desire.
T.working_hook_fa: گوچی قیمت کیفش را ۳۰٪ کم کرد. در دنیای لاکچری، این یک اعتراف است.
T.working_hook_en: Gucci just cut a bag's price by 30%. In luxury, that's a confession.

key_sources.claim: Headline: 'Gucci Price Cuts Break Luxury's Biggest Taboo. Louis Vuitton Isn't Following.' Some Gucci prices cut by 30% as middle-class shoppers retreat; cuts surfaced via shoppers, social accounts and Google price flags before any executive comment; Kering frames it as a 'price architecture' reset. Body details read via extraction summary — use only where corroborated.

Padlock Crystal Small handbag: EUR 3,500 in France in July, now EUR 2,450 (-30%), per Bernstein, first reported by the Wall Street Journal. LVMH discussing responses such as price cuts; a year earlier its CFO Cecile Cabanis ruled out price adjustments and said the company 'was not Coca-Cola' (paraphrase, translated). Goldman Sachs estimates Louis Vuitton Q3 sales down 8%.

Same Padlock figures (EUR 3,500 -> 2,450, -30%); 16 new bag styles at $2,000 or less on Gucci's US site. Cabanis quoted (translated): 'We are not Coca-Cola' (a year ago) vs now 'discussing bold and immediate measures, such as price cuts, internally.' LV holding prices out of concern that cuts could damage brand value.

Cuts on selected handbags, footwear and ready-to-wear; new Padlock price is a regular selling price, not a markdown; sneakers EUR 800 -> 560-595; Mercato tote reportedly 20-25% cheaper. Kering Q3 presentation: 'reshaping of product and price architecture, with targeted adjustments to improve perceived value, led by Handbags'. Flag credited to Bernstein's Luca Solca.
Padlock figures (about 30%, per Bernstein's Luca Solca); cuts reported by WSJ; LVMH has not announced a broad price-cutting strategy for Louis Vuitton.

'They said prices would never drop': Gucci, Boucheron, Van Cleef & Arpels cutting Korean prices; Gucci Mercato Small Tote 4.45M -> 3.5M won (~-21%); luxury department-store growth slowed from 40%+ (Q2) to ~10% (Oct); Prada CEO Andrea Guerra: 'The mere fact that pricing is being talked about means there is a problem.'
Gucci Q3 2026 revenue EUR 1.29bn, -4% reported, -6% comparable; retail -9% comparable. Luca de Meo: 'The recovery of Gucci remains our defining priority.'
Hermes Q3 2026 revenue +4.3% at constant rates to EUR 4,096m; leather goods and saddlery +10.8% to EUR 1,912m. (No price statement in this article.)

T.framing_note: Type 1 (famous-brand move with public reaction), sparked 15-17 Nov (WSJ/Bernstein), Korea follow-up 26 Nov. Spine: (1) Hook: Gucci cut a bag 30%; in luxury that's a confession. (2) The bag: Padlock, EUR 3,500 in July, EUR 2,450 now (France) — the one number on screen is 30% (or the two prices as one comparison). (3) Nobody announced it; analysts and shoppers spotted it. Kering calls it 'targeted adjustments to improve perceived value'. (4) Luxury's unwritten rule: never get cheaper; the price is part of what you buy. (5) Two messages from one cut: 'buy now' to newcomers, 'you overpaid' to owners. (6) Louis Vuitton's owner, a year ago: 'We're not Coca-Cola.' Now it is discussing cuts (has NOT cut). (7) Hermès didn't cut; its leather goods grew 10.8% last quarter. (8) Lesson: before you discount, ask whether you have a price problem or a desire problem. A discount fixes the first, never the second. Rules: say 'reported' / 'analysts spotted', never 'Gucci announced'; 'some bags, shoes and clothes', never 'Gucci slashed all prices'; LV 'is discussing', never 'LV cut'; do not call it viral; do not put Bain customer numbers, '13 quarters' or share-price numbers on screen (not read at primary level). No AI-drawn Gucci, LV or Hermès logos, monograms or bag designs; real bag image or logo only from owner uploads (T-a, T-b), framed and credited; any price-tag mockup is blank + official logo per motion.md §9 and captioned as an editorial mockup. Not financial advice; no recommendation to buy or not buy. Distinct from 11-03/11-09/11-13 (price perception) — this is price as a brand signal. Never name the UAE, Dubai or any emirate.
